title: The Woolrich experience: Bespoke tailoring in Bangkok designed around the modern traveller
desc: The Woolrich experience: Bespoke tailoring in Bangkok designed around the modern traveller Legacy Woolrich Bespoke Tailor is positioning itself as a traveller-friendly tailoring house in Bangkok, offering a flexible service model that combines walk-in access, appointment-based consultations, remote ordering and worldwide shipping. Based on Silom Road in Bang Rak, the business is known for fast turnaround options, including an express service that can produce garments in as little as 24 hours, while maintaining a 5/5 rating, which is a measure of their consistency. Walk-ins and flexibility Woolrich has an open-door approach that allows customers to walk in without long lead times or a formal schedule. The team said it aims to keep the experience welcoming and low-pressure, particularly for visitors working around flights, meetings or short stays in Bangkok. Standard tailoring at Woolrich takes two to three days, giving garments the time needed for proper construction and fitting. title_cn: 30多年来只做收购 泰国正大集团为何现在要出售肯德基业务
summary_cn: 正大集团（Thai Beverage）在过去30多年中几乎只进行收购业务，罕见地计划出售旗下盈利良好的肯德基（KFC）资产。这标志着集团首次以卖方身份处理重大资产。分析认为，即使该业务仍处于增长期，集团仍做出出售决定，背后战略动因值得关注。

title_cn: 央行管控措施：18岁以下儿童账户日转账额度受限

title: Missing Russian siblings found murdered, buried in Pattaya, suspects arrested
desc: Missing Russian siblings found murdered, buried in Pattaya, suspects arrested Legacy Two Thai men arrested today, July 31, in Sa Kaeo over the disappearance of two Russian siblings in Pattaya reportedly confessed to killing them and burying their bodies. The case attracted public attention after the Russian mother, Sarina Nazimova, reported her children, 22 year old Diana Nazimova and 17 year old Roman Nazimova, missing at Huay Yai Police Station on July 28. Police said CCTV footage showed the siblings for the last time near a bridge on the Map Ta Phut-Na Jomtien Motorway. The pair were seen speaking with an unidentified man and being followed by another motorcyclist shortly before they disappeared. On July 29, residents alerted police after seeing four men carrying digging equipment near an abandoned crematorium close to the bridge at about 10pm on July 28. Thana “Pong” Kirdthong | Photo via Amarin TV Officers searched the area and found the motorcycle rented by the Russian siblings dismantled and buried in two separate pits. title: Thai embassy denies receiving early report of YouTuber’s death
desc: Thai embassy denies receiving early report of YouTuber’s death Legacy The Royal Thai Embassy in Ankara called on Georgian authorities to clarify why notification of the Hlun Solo death was delayed , saying it did not receive any official report on July 14 despite claims circulating on social media. The embassy and the family of Thai travel YouTuber, Hlun Solo, whose real name was Bawonthat Pengsuk, confirmed his death on July 30 after he had been reported missing during a solo trip to Georgia . According to Thai media reports, Hlun checked into a hotel in Tbilisi on July 13 and was later found dead in his room after hotel staff checked on him when he failed to leave the accommodation. Thai media reported that Georgian police found no visible signs of injury on the body. His body was transferred to the Levan Samkharauli National Forensics Bureau for an autopsy, and the cause of death remains under investigation. Photo via Facebook/ ฮลุน โซโล่ Thai travel blogger Akira “Wanchai” Wongseng, who helped search for Hlun , said he had spoken with Georgian police, who told him the body had been discovered on July 14. The reported timeline prompted questions from the public

title: Is Thailand safe to visit? What every tourist (and expats) should know
desc: Is Thailand safe to visit? What every tourist (and expats) should know Legacy Thailand receives more than 35 million international visitors a year. The vast majority leave without any safety incident worth reporting. So when people ask whether Thailand is safe, the accurate answer is yes, with some qualifications that are worth understanding before you arrive rather than after. The three areas that actually catch tourists and expats out are road safety, scams, and the legal framework. Natural hazards matter in specific seasons and locations. Violent crime against foreign visitors is rare, but it is not zero. Here is what the evidence shows for each. title: Andros Townsend misses Thailand’s cheap coconuts after US stay
desc: Andros Townsend misses Thailand’s cheap coconuts after US stay Legacy Former England footballer Andros Townsend has praised Thailand’s cheap fresh coconuts after revealing they cost nearly eight times less than in the United States. Townsend, who is set to join PT Prachuap FC, posted a video on his TikTok account yesterday, July 30, showing himself buying an aromatic coconut from a roadside stall in Thailand. Townsend said he had missed his daily coconuts after spending a month in the United States during the FIFA World Cup 2026 , adding that he was back to natural electrolytes. He noted that an aromatic coconut in Thailand costs just 20 baht, or about 45 pence. By comparison, he said a coconut in the United States costs US$4.99 (around 160 baht), nearly eight times the price. @androstownsend Nobody talks about how hard it is to go from this… 😂🥥 20 baht, which equals just 45p… then spending a month in the US where the same coconut was $4.99. 😭 Safe to say I’ve missed my daily coconuts. desc: Thai man swims across Thai-Cambodian border after scam operation escape Legacy A Thai man swam across a border canal into Thailand today, July 31, after escaping a scam operation in Poipet , Cambodia, where he said he had been forced to work for more than three years after being lured by a fake job advertisement on TikTok. Soldiers from the Burapha Task Force, including the Aranyaprathet Task Force intelligence unit and Ranger Company 1203, detained the 19 year old near a natural border crossing in Tha Kham subdistrict, Aranyaprathet district, Sa Kaeo province. The officers had been monitoring the area following reports of an illegal border crossing . They spotted the Thai man emerging from the border area on foot and detained him. No smuggler was found with him. Photo via Amarin TV The man told investigators that three years ago he applied for a job through TikTok after seeing an advertisement for a chat administrator position offering a monthly salary of 20,000 baht. title: Why Phuket property management has become essential for overseas owners
desc: Why Phuket property management has become essential for overseas owners Legacy Phuket is in the middle of a property boom, and the buyers are no longer mostly local. According to C9 Hotelworks’ 2025 Phuket market update , the island handled around 8.8 million airport arrivals last year. Fresh demand is coming from India, South Korea, and the Middle East as Chinese travel slowly returns. Many of the people buying homes here come from Russia and CIS countries, Europe, the Gulf, and India, and a large share will never live on the island full time. That one fact has quietly reshaped the market. It has turned property management into one of the most important businesses in Phuket. When an owner lives in Dubai or London, the property in Rawai does not run itself. Someone has to handle the bookings, the pricing, the cleaning, the guest at midnight, the broken pump, and a growing list of legal rules. This is the gap a professional manager fills. It is also why a few established operators have grown alongside the boom. title: Japanese prosecutors drop charges against Thai woman found with crystal meth
desc: Japanese prosecutors drop charges against Thai woman found with crystal meth Legacy Japanese prosecutors dropped legal proceedings against a Thai woman who was arrested at Fukuoka Airport after crystal meth was discovered hidden inside coffee and tea packages she was carrying. The arrest of the 28 year old Juthathip in Japan attracted public attention after her family appealed to Thai authorities and the media, maintaining that she had unknowingly transported the drugs after being recruited by a suspected trafficking network. According to Juthathip’s boyfriend, the couple operated a courier service transporting goods between Thailand and Japan . He said Juthathip was contacted through the LINE application by a user identified as “Ing Ing”, who offered her 3,500 baht to transport 12 kilogrammes of goods to Fukuoka. The boyfriend said the couple travelled to Japan on July 12 carrying nine parcels, accompanied by another person. He said immigration officers questioned three of them on arrival, but Juthathip was the only person detained. Juthathip’s mother | Photo via MGR Online Her boyfriend and parents were later informed that crystal meth was found concealed

title: Rodtang apologises to ONE, vows world title return
desc: Rodtang apologises to ONE, vows world title return Legacy Rodtang Jitmuangnon has apologised to ONE Championship and the promotion’s matchmaking team following recent misunderstandings, admitting he was influenced by people seeking to benefit from his success. The former ONE Flyweight Muay Thai world champion shared the statement on his Facebook page yesterday, July 30, after signing a new contract with ONE Championship, ending months of uncertainty over his future with the organisation. The dispute was eventually resolved with the help of senior figures from Jitmuangnon Gym. “I’d like to use this opportunity to clarify everything one final time so I can move forward and focus on my future,” Rodtang wrote. He said that after achieving fame and financial success, many new people entered his life, but not all of them had good intentions. “Many of them were only interested in benefiting from me financially. I don’t want to go into detail, but I made the mistake of following the advice of that group. I’ve now completely cut ties with those people and removed them from my life.” Photo via Facebook: Rodtang Jitmuangnon Rodtang also addresse

title: 投资额飙升！泰国迈向全球“光”生产基地
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 7月30日，AI热潮不仅为芯片制造商或数据中心带来了机遇，还推动了光子产业的发展，这种利用“光”进行高速数据传输的通信技术，是AI、云计算和新一代通信网络的核心所在。泰国投资促进委员会（BOI）透露，2021年至2026年6月期间，光子产业的投资项目共79个，总投资额超过827亿泰铢，表明泰国正在逐步成为全球AI产业链的重要生产基地。 互联网用户在使用AI、在线观看视频或进行视频会议时，海量数据都会通过光纤和光子技术进行传输，这种传输速度更快、能耗更低，且能承载巨量数据的技术，在AI数据中心和云计算系统中不可或缺。泰国的光子产业并非仅生产零配件，而是拥有涵盖整个产业链的投资，从光纤、光学元件到用于连接AI数据中心服务器的光收发器，应有尽有。 泰国的多家生产商已经成为英伟达（Nvidia）、思科（Cisco）和亚马逊云科技（AWS）等全球科技巨头的供应商，同时也为泰国本土创造了超过20,000个就业岗位。另外，超过60%的项目位于东部经济走廊（EEC）以外的地区，有助于将投资和就业分流至多个府。 超过827亿泰铢的投资是推动泰国向高新技术升级的重要机遇，但面临着重大挑战，比如泰国是将仅仅作为“生产基地”，还是能够进一步延伸至自主研发与创新；还有一个关键课题是，如何培养足够的高技能人才以满足产业需求。 虽然光子产业的投资数据表明，泰国在全球AI产业链中扮演着越来越重要的角色，但AI时代的竞争不只取决于资金投入，更在于“人才”与“知识储备”的较量，只有具备培养人才、发展开发技术，以及在本土创造附加价值的能力，才能在未来实现从“生产基地”向“创新基地”的转变。 （编译：KA；来源：pptvhd36） The post 投资额飙升！泰国迈向全球“光”生产基地 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 曼谷核心区要禁非电动“嘟嘟车”？
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 7月31日，泰国陆路运输厅近日通过官方网站就禁止内燃机“嘟嘟车”驶入曼谷核心区公开征求意见，旨在治理噪音和空气污染问题。陆运厅表示，曼谷核心区汇集了泰国诸多重要场所，如玉佛寺、各大皇家寺庙和国家级古迹等，是国内外游客青睐的旅游打卡地，有必要将其划定为内燃机三轮出租车“嘟嘟车”的管控区。 为此，陆运厅制定了《禁止特定类型三轮出租车在曼谷核心区行驶的部级法规（草案）》，并于2026年7月28日至8月27日期间开放公众意见征集，以便将各方反馈纳入后续考量。该法规草案的核心原则为：禁止内燃机三轮出租车在曼谷核心区内行驶，但电动三轮出租车（电动“嘟嘟车”）或政府公告允许的时段除外。 玉佛寺周边区域的“嘟嘟车”司机普遍对该法规草案持反对意见。他们说，电动“嘟嘟车”的租金很贵，和每日收入相比并不划算，而且玉佛寺紧邻大皇宫，所有司机都十分配合，没有私自改装排气管制造噪音，车辆大多保持着出厂原装的引擎，如果真要解决问题，更应该去治理公交车排放黑烟造成的空气污染。 一些游客群体认为，由“嘟嘟车”带来的噪音和空气污染问题是可以通过政府部门与司机双方沟通、共同协商解决的。如果未来真的立法禁止内燃机“嘟嘟车”在各大景点为游客提供服务，可能会削弱泰国的特色形象，因为在外国游客眼中，“嘟嘟车”是泰国的标志之一，是人生中值得体验的特色项目。 （编译：KA；来源：ch7） The post 曼谷核心区要禁非电动“嘟嘟车”？ appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 曼谷核心区拟禁内燃机三轮出租车，保护名胜古迹环境
summary_cn: 泰国陆路运输厅提出草案，拟禁止内燃机三轮出租车（「嘟嘟车」）在曼谷核心区行驶，以治理噪音和空气污染。核心区包含玉佛寺、皇家寺庙等重要场所。但司机反对，认为电动车成本高；游客担忧禁令会削弱泰国特色。陆运厅于7月28日至8月27日开放意见征集。各方建议通过协商和管理公交排放等措施解决问题。

title: 清迈“最热”，中国游客暑期出境游首选泰国
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 7月30日，中国在线旅游平台“去哪儿（Qunar）”透露，泰国是2026年暑期中国大陆游客出境游的第一大目的地，其中清迈因体验式旅游热潮，如学做泰国菜、练泰拳和瑜伽等备受青睐，其酒店预订量增幅高达3.3倍。据悉，这几年游客的出行习惯正在发生变化，体验式旅游和在旅途中学习新技能越来越受到关注。 其他受中国大陆游客喜爱的热门出境游目的地还包括：韩国、马来西亚、新加坡、中国香港、印度尼西亚和美国。与此同时，中国大陆的入境旅游市场也在持续扩大，上海、北京、广州和成都等城市最受外国游客欢迎。从客源地来看，今年暑期入境中国大陆游客数量最多的国家和地区包括：泰国、加拿大、美国、英国和俄罗斯；另外，来自希腊、斯里兰卡、蒙古、瑞典、芬兰和墨西哥的游客数量也有明显增长。 （编译：KA；来源：thebangkokinsight） The post 清迈“最热”，中国游客暑期出境游首选泰国 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
